drinks.name: Brown Sugar Syrup
method: In a medium saucepan over medium heat, whisk together the brown sugar and water. Add the cinnamon sticks. Bring to a boil, stirring to dissolve the sugar.
Reduce heat and simmer about 2 minutes, until the sugar is completely dissolved.
Remove from heat and cool completely. Remove the cinnamon sticks, pour into a glass jar, and store in the refrigerator.
drinks.note: Cooling before straining lets the cinnamon keep infusing the syrup.

drinks.name: Pumpkin Spice Sauce

ingredients.item: Water (1 cup for a thicker sauce)

method: Combine the brown sugar, maple syrup, pumpkin purée, water, pumpkin pie spice, cinnamon and salt in a saucepan.
Bring to a low simmer and cook 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
drinks.note: 2 cups water = thinner, pourable syrup. 1 cup water = thicker sauce.

drinks.name: Salted Maple Cold Foam
method: Combine the heavy cream, whole milk, maple syrup and salt in a blender or with a milk frother.
Whip until light and foamy but still pourable — thick enough to float on top of a drink.
drinks.note: 2:1:1 (cream:milk:flavor) is the base ratio for every cold foam on the menu.

drinks.name: Pumpkin Pie Cold Foam

ingredients.item: Pumpkin Pie Spice — for visible flecks

method: Combine the heavy cream, whole milk, Pumpkin Spice Sauce, salt and pumpkin pie spice in a blender or with a milk frother.
Whip until light and foamy but still pourable — thick enough to float on top of a drink.
Dust with an extra pinch of pumpkin pie spice on top right before serving, for visible flecks and aroma.
drinks.note: Pumpkin Spice Sauce already carries sweetness and spice — it swaps 1:1 for maple syrup in the base ratio.
